passage: A, B, C, D, and E are seated in a straight row facing North (not necessarily in the same order). A sits to the immediate right of B. D sits at the extreme right end. C is the immediate neighbour of both B and E.

questions.question: Who sits at the extreme left end?
questions.explanation: Working out the arrangement: D is at extreme right (pos 5). A is immediately right of B. C is immediate neighbour of both B and E. Only valid arrangement: E-C-B-A-D. So E sits at the extreme left.

questions.question: Who sits in the middle (3rd position)?
questions.explanation: The arrangement is E-C-B-A-D (left to right). The middle (3rd) position is occupied by B.

questions.question: Who sits immediately to the left of D?
questions.explanation: The arrangement is E-C-B-A-D. D is at pos 5 (extreme right), so A at pos 4 is immediately to its left.

questions.question: How many persons sit between C and A?
questions.explanation: Arrangement: E-C-B-A-D. C is at pos 2, A is at pos 4. One person (B) sits between them.

questions.question: Who sits immediately to the right of E?
questions.explanation: Arrangement: E-C-B-A-D. E is at pos 1, C is at pos 2. C sits immediately to the right of E.

passage: Six people P, Q, R, S, T, and U are sitting in a row facing North. Q sits third from the left end. P sits to the immediate right of Q. Only two persons sit between P and T. S sits to the immediate left of R. U is not an immediate neighbour of P.

questions.question: Who sits at the extreme right end?
questions.explanation: Q is at pos 3; P (immediate right of Q) is at pos 4. T must be 2 positions from P → T at pos 1 or pos 7 (invalid), so T at pos 1. S is immediately left of R, U is not adjacent to P. Remaining positions 2,5,6 for U,S,R: S-R must be adjacent → S at pos 5, R at pos 6. U at pos 2. Arrangement: T-U-Q-P-S-R. R is at extreme right.

questions.question: Who sits second from the left end?
questions.explanation: Arrangement: T-U-Q-P-S-R. U is at the 2nd position from the left.

questions.question: How many persons sit between Q and S?
questions.explanation: Arrangement: T-U-Q-P-S-R. Q is at pos 3 and S is at pos 5. Only P (pos 4) sits between them.

questions.question: Who is the immediate neighbour of both U and P?
questions.explanation: Arrangement: T-U-Q-P-S-R. Q at pos 3 has U (pos 2) on its left and P (pos 4) on its right.

questions.question: What is the position of T from the right end?
questions.explanation: Arrangement: T-U-Q-P-S-R. T is at pos 1 from the left, which is the 6th position from the right.
